title: Teachers Management
subtitle: Base control and links with units.

step.documento: Enter the teacher's ID (CPF, DNI or SSN). This is how the system recognizes the person.
step.contato: New ID. Now the email and WhatsApp, to check whether they are already in the schedule.
step.parecidas: We found similar records. Check whether it is the same person.
step.achado: Teacher found. Choose the unit to link.

cpf.similarIntro: These old records have no ID yet and match what you typed. If it is the same person, the ID is saved on it and nobody is duplicated.
cpf.willSaveDocument: The ID will be saved on this record.
cpf.orphan: This ID is reserved for a record that no longer exists. Ask the administrator to release it.
cpf.searchError: Could not search now (offline or quota exhausted). Try again.
cpf.emailInvalid: Invalid email. Check that it is complete (e.g. name@gmail.com).
cpf.emailFake: This email looks fake (e.g. naoinformou@, teste@). Ask for the teacher's real email.
cpf.phoneInvalid: Invalid WhatsApp: include the area code and avoid repeated digits.
cpf.emailOfOther: This email already belongs to {{name}}'s record, which has another ID. Check the email.
cpf.emailTaken: This email is already on {{name}}'s record. If it is not the same person, fix that record's email first.
cpf.inUse: This ID is already registered to another person. Check the numbers; if it is a mistake, talk to the mentor.
cpf.onlyStaffSees: ID provided. Only the admin and the mentor see and fix the number.
cpf.optionalHint: Optional for now: fill it in to complete the record. Kept in a protected area (only admin and mentor see it).
cpf.fixHint: Change only if the number is wrong.
cpf.replacesOldLogin: This record is linked to another login (usually the old password one). Confirming makes it use this person's new login.
cpf.fromLogin: This ID belongs to the access (login) of {{name}} ({{email}}). Linking it to the schedule record avoids a duplicate.

searchPlaceholder: Search by name, phone or email...
loadMoreData: Loading data consumes reads. Use wisely.

verifyModal.title: Add Teacher

formModal.noLoginNote: This only creates the teacher's record.
